name: Swan River
blurb: Quiet valley float into Bigfork. Take out above the Wild Mile unless you meant to run Class III.

sections.notes: Mellow until town. The Wild Mile gorge at Bigfork is a separate Class III run — don't float into it by accident.
sections.accessReview: A usable take-out above the Wild Mile has not been confirmed. The mapped Bigfork boat ramp is a different location and must not be substituted. This section is not ready for trip planning.
